name: Stoney
backstory:
__NOTOC__
Stoney is a Mud Elemental at the Circus of the Last Days. She and her husband Boney run Stoney and Boney's Bespoke Creations, with Boney running sales and Stoney sculpting. Stoney speaks with the sound of earth moving and rock falling; , the language of creatures from the earth elemental plane.
